scenes.name: lola/beat
scenes.ovoz: Lola never passed a mirror without stopping. Not a shop window. Not a puddle. Not once.

scenes.name: lola/beat
scenes.ovoz: Her phone held twelve thousand selfies. And today needed the perfect one: the city's biggest fashion party.

scenes.name: lola/beat
scenes.ovoz: She walked the street like a runway, eyes on one screen only: her own.

scenes.name: lola/beat
scenes.ovoz: Then an old man slipped. Oranges rolled into the mud... and everyone kept walking.

scenes.name: lola/beat
scenes.ovoz: Lola looked at her white dress.

scenes.name: lola/beat
scenes.ovoz: Then she knelt right into the mud.

scenes.name: lola/beat
scenes.ovoz: At the party, everyone stared. For the first time, Lola didn't want a single photo.

scenes.name: lola/beat
scenes.ovoz: But a stranger had filmed her in the rain. By morning, a million people had seen it.

scenes.name: lola/beat
scenes.ovoz: Her best picture ever was the one she never took.
